features.title: An endless world
features.description: Every game generates a fresh, procedurally-built 2D world. Wander across grassland, forest, jungle and mountain biomes with no edge in sight.

features.title: Survive & explore
features.description: Energy drains as you roam, so eat what you gather or hunt to keep going. A day/night cycle turns over the world while you push further out.

features.title: Craft & build
features.description: Gather wood and stone to craft floors, beds, fences, chests, campfires and torches — then carve a home out of the wilderness.

features.title: Farm & forage
features.description: Plant wheat, watch crops mature, and pick apples and bananas. Build a food supply so the next expedition lasts longer.

features.title: A living ecosystem
features.description: Chickens, rabbits, deer, bears, wolves and snakes move, feed and reproduce on their own — the world keeps living whether you watch or not.

features.title: Two ways to play
features.description: Play the full graphical game, or drop into the built-in text mode (--text) to roam from any terminal — over SSH, on a Chromebook, or headless.
